diagnosis.root_cause: The customer's CATV service is provisioned and the ONU supports CATV, but catv_synced is 0. Internet service, EPON optics, authentication, VLAN 1037, router, OLT, and PON peers are healthy, indicating an RF/CATV synchronization or signal-drift fault on this customer's CATV path.
evidence: The complaint is limited to TV channels; Internet traffic is active and stable.
The subscriber has has_catv=1, catv_service=1, and profile_CATV, but catv_synced=0, directly showing that CATV is not synchronized.
The ONU is online with RX -20.4 dBm and TX 2.45 dBm, both within normal EPON ranges.
Seven days of RX, TX, distance, and bias telemetry are stable: distance remains 118, RX remains around -20.4 dBm, TX remains near 2.3 dBm, and TX bias remains within the healthy range.
All tested peers on EPON0/7 are online, so there is no evidence of a shared PON, splitter, port, or OLT failure.
The OLT responds to ping and SNMP, has normal CPU, memory, and temperature, and all eight PONs are healthy.
The router heartbeat is healthy, RADIUS state matches CRM, sessions are normal at two in 24 hours, and session durations are near the network mean.
The expected customer VLAN 1037 is present and correctly assigned, ruling out the default VLAN 46 or a provisioning VLAN fault.
The fault is therefore confined to the CATV/RF service path rather than the EPON data path.

remediation.action: Check the customer's coaxial/RF drop, connectors, splitter, and CATV input level; verify CATV frequency and channel plan, then retune or reprovision the CATV service and confirm that the ONU reaches CATV sync. Escalate to field service if the RF level or drop is out of specification.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
